gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Vintage and hard to miss. Vast Shadow cuts every stroke to a single width, while Noto Sans Gothic loosens up below with big, bead-round counters in a plain sans.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-hk: Vast Shadow looks bent from one length of tubing, with a tall mean line and generous side space. Noto Sans HK is the plain sans that does the quiet work, its large lowercase and lifted brush ends carrying the text.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-imperial-ar: Vast Shadow's round o has sides and top equally thick. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic keeps its c ends pointing apart like pincers, so on a page you can give that sans-serif body the room to be friendly.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Approachable is the mood of Noto Sans Kannada, whose s curves open wide at both ends beneath Vast Shadow's toothpaste-line strokes. One sets the tone, the other does the talking.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Noto Sans Kharoshthi reads thick and dark, its curves never closing back on themselves, line after line. Yet Vast Shadow above it keeps a quiet, level beat, with no accents of weight to interrupt the page.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Glass tubing bent into letters: that is Vast Shadow, tall and vintage. Noto Sans Khojki steps in below as a plain sans with wide exits and a large, clear eye on every e.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Vast Shadow looks traced with one marker, every stroke the same width under a tall mean line. Noto Sans Limbu then reads in sans-serif letters with gaping curves and tall-bodied small forms, easy going over many lines.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Vast Shadow has no thick and thin parts in any letter, which gives it a vintage hum. Yet Noto Sans Lydian, a sans-serif with capitals barely taller than lowercase, keeps a long read mild and approachable.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-medefaidrin: Noto Sans Medefaidrin brings lowercase that rises high and curves with no ink pooling. Noto Sans Medefaidrin pairs with Vast Shadow's uniform joints, and a modest body size lets that sans-serif breathe.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-meetei-maye: Contemporary Noto Sans Meetei Mayek is the body here, so Vast Shadow gets the big, short lines. Vast Shadow runs a single track width like neon tube, while Noto Sans Meetei Mayek has rounds that gap like a cracked bangle.
